title: Pass The Spin Pass Hands Through (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the pass is the lifeblood
Spin it tight, hands through the target
Fingertips finish where the ball must go

[Verse 1]
Ball in two hands, fingers spread on the seam
Lead hand under, trail hand on top, the team
Swing the ball across the body, hip to hip
Release at the front, let the spin grip

[Pre-Chorus]
Follow through with the hands to the receiver
Fingertips point at the target, the giver
Weight transfers from back foot to front foot
Step into the pass, son, dont stay put

[Chorus]
Pass the spin pass hands through, son
Fingertips at the target, the work is done
Swing across the body, release in front
Receiver in the chest, never the hunt

[Verse 2]
Short pass three metres, soft hands cradle
Medium pass eight metres, full swing label
Long pass fifteen metres, full body rotation
Spiral tight, son, perfect notation

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the pass is given, not thrown
Lead the runner into space, sown
Pass to where they will be, not where they are
A half stride ahead, son, raise the bar

[Chorus]
Pass the spin pass hands through, son
Fingertips at the target, the work is done
Swing across the body, release in front
Receiver in the chest, never the hunt

[Outro]
Spin tight, hands through
Lead the runner, son, that is true
Three, eight, fifteen metres
Thats my boy, the pass meters
